  rel <- coalesce(

    as.numeric(haven::zap_labels(FDREL00_PARTNER)),
    as.numeric(haven::zap_labels(GDREL00_PARTNER))
  )
  use_main <- !is.na(rel)

  sex <- if_else(
    use_main,
    as.numeric(haven::zap_labels(respondent_sex)),
    as.numeric(haven::zap_labels(respondent_sex_PARTNER))
  )
  case_when(
    sweep <= 4 & code %in% c(1, 4, 7, 10) ~ "Mother",
    sweep <= 4 & code %in% c(2, 5, 8, 11) ~ "Father",
    sweep <= 4 & code %in% c(3, 6, 9, 12) & sex %in% 2 ~ "Mother",
    sweep <= 4 & code %in% c(3, 6, 9, 12) & sex %in% 1 ~ "Father",
    sweep <= 4 & code %in% 13:18 ~ "Other carer",
    sweep >= 5 & code %in% 7:10 & sex %in% 2 ~ "Mother",
    sweep >= 5 & code %in% 7:10 & sex %in% 1 ~ "Father",
    sweep >= 5 & code %in% 11:20 ~ "Other carer",
    !is.na(code) ~ "Unknown",
    !is.na(G_OUT_PARQUEST) ~ "Unknown",
    .default = NA_character_
  )
})
